name: cliamp
title: Cliamp
description: Control and manage the cliamp terminal music player — playback, search, playlists, queue, and daemon — over its local IPC socket.
author: rickdronkers

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: See the current track and control playback, volume, shuffle, repeat, EQ, and speed.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Music
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: Search any configured provider (radio, local, podcasts, streaming services) and play or queue results.

commands.name: queue
commands.title: Live Playlist
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: View and manage the live playlist: play, reorder, queue next, remove.

commands.name: playlists
commands.title: Browse Playlists
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: Browse provider playlists, load them, or drill into their tracks.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Now Playing in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: Current track and playback controls in the macOS menu bar.

commands.name: play-station
commands.title: Play Station
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: Play a radio station by name — searches your favorites first, then the radio directory. Ideal as a Quicklink target.

commands.name: start-daemon
commands.title: Start Cliamp Daemon
commands.subtitle: cliamp
commands.description: Start the headless cliamp daemon if it is not running.

preferences.name: cliampPath
preferences.title: cliamp Binary
preferences.description: Path to the cliamp executable (used to auto-start the daemon).

preferences.name: autoStart
preferences.label: Auto-start daemon
preferences.description: Start cliamp --daemon automatically when a command finds it not running.
